info.name: Application Performance Monitoring Trace Explorer Attributes API
Activate a set of attributes for the given APM Domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

items.docs:
Activates a set of attributes for the given APM Domain.  Attribute names are not case-sensitive.  Any duplicates present in the bulk activation
request are deduplicated and only unique attributes are activated.  A maximum number of 700 string attributes and 100 numeric attributes
can be activated in an APM Domain subject to the available string and numeric slots.  Once an attribute has been activated, it may take some time

info.name: Turn on or off autoactivation for private data key or public data key traffic in the APM Domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

params.name: isAutoActivateOn
params.description: Autoactivate toggle switch.  Set to true to turn on auto-activate.  Set to false to turn off auto-activate.

params.name: dataKeyType
params.description: Data key type for which auto-activate needs to be turned on or off.

items.docs: Turn on or off autoactivate for private data key or public data key traffic a given APM Domain.

info.name: DeActivate a set of attributes for the given APM Domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

items.docs:

info.name: Pin a set of attributes in the APM Domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

items.docs:
Pin a set of attributes in the APM Domain.  Attributes that are marked pinned are not autoactivated by ingest.
Attributes that are deactivated are pinned by default.

info.name: Unpin a set of attributes in the APM Domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

items.docs: Unpin a set of attributes in the APM Domain.

params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

items.docs: Update a set of attribute properties in the APM Domain.

info.name: Update notes to a set of attributes in the APM Domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

items.docs:
Add or edit notes to a set of attributes in the APM Domain.  Notes can be added to either an active or an inactive attribute.  The
notes will be preserved even if the attribute changes state (when an active attribute is deactivated or when an inactive attribute
is activated).
